info.title: jevtester
info.summary: Test decision models, the questions written for them, and the decisions built on their answers.

get.description: List targets, their capabilities, and their last health check.

post.description: Run every target's health check and return the targets with the results.

Send one request to each chosen target and return one result per target.

A target that can't take the request, because it isn't ready or a preflight check fails, still has a result,
with `ok: false` and an error.

get.description: List the suites under `suites/`.
Return a suite with its cases and its question set's current version.
Validate a suite and run the question-wording checks on its question set.

post.description: Add a case to a suite's YAML file. A case id the suite already has is a conflict.

409.description: Conflict, or a target that isn't ready

get.description: List the question sets under `suites/`.
Return a question set's current version, the suites that use it, and its wording checks.

put.description: Save new questions to a question set's YAML file, which makes a new version. Creates the set if it's new.

get.description: List a question set's versions by hash, newest first.
Return one version of a question set.
Compare two versions of a question set.
List runs, newest first.

post.description: Start a run of a suite on the chosen targets. Follow it with `GET /api/runs/{id}/events`.

get.description: Return a run's settings, status, and counts.

Stream a run's progress as server-sent events.

Each event's SSE `event` field is its `type`, and its `data` is a [`RunEvent`][jevtester.schemas.RunEvent] as
JSON. The first event is always `progress`, with the current counts, so a client that reconnects needs no
history. A run that has ended sends `progress` and then its final event. The stream ends after `finished`,
`cancelled`, or `error`.

post.description: Cancel a queued or running run. Cancelling a run that has ended returns it unchanged.

get.description: Return metrics for each target and question.
Return the confusion matrix for one choice question and one target.
Return a reliability table for one noul or choice question and one target.
Return the answers that changed from a baseline run, with McNemar's test for each target.
Return one case in a run, with every target's full result.
Return a run's summary and metrics, and the same report as Markdown.
Return how often each case's answers changed under each probe variant.

post.description: Start a probe run. It streams events like any run, and `GET /api/runs/{id}/probes` returns its results.

get.description: List the policies under `suites/`.
Return a policy's YAML text and what it defines.

put.description: Validate and save a policy's YAML text. An invalid policy returns 422 with every error in `details`.

post.description: Sweep one threshold over a finished run's answers and return the trade-off points.

AnswerChange.title: AnswerChange
AnswerChange.description: A case whose answer changed from the baseline run.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: The body of every 4xx and 5xx response.

Calibration.title: Calibration
Calibration.description:
A reliability table for one question and one target.

For a noul question the predicted value is the probability of yes. For a choice question it's the probability of
the chosen option, and the observed rate is how often that choice was correct.

CalibrationBin.title: CalibrationBin
CalibrationBin.description: One probability bin of a reliability table.

Capabilities.title: Capabilities
Capabilities.description: What a target accepts and returns. `None` means the limit is unknown, so preflight doesn't check it.

Case-Input.title: Case

Case-Output.title: Case
Case-Output.description: One state, with the answers and action it expects.

CaseCreated.title: CaseCreated

ChangeSummary.title: ChangeSummary

ChoiceAnswer.title: ChoiceAnswer
ChoiceAnswer.description: The answer to a choice question.

ChoiceQuestion-Input.title: ChoiceQuestion

ChoiceQuestion-Output.title: ChoiceQuestion
ChoiceQuestion-Output.description: A question that picks one option from a map of option names to descriptions.

ConfusionMatrix.title: ConfusionMatrix
ConfusionMatrix.description: Expected options against answered options, for one choice question and one target.

DecideBody.title: DecideBody

Expectation-Output.title: Expectation
Expectation-Output.description: The answer a case expects to one question.

NoulAnswer.title: NoulAnswer

NoulCriteria-Output.title: NoulCriteria
NoulCriteria-Output.description: Optional descriptions of the yes and no outcomes of a noul question.

NoulQuestion-Input.title: NoulQuestion

NoulQuestion-Output.title: NoulQuestion
NoulQuestion-Output.description: A yes/no question. Its answer is the probability of yes.
